answer: What survives to the atlas is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A prism of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ember of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit.
